a.text: Concern about our agreement: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so if we both operate in round 1 we'll most likely both be caught with empty units. The reserve's 4 cells can only fully protect one of us right now. I don't want to break our deal behind your back, so I'm raising it openly. Are you willing to renegotiate, or do you want to stick with operate-until-8? Tell me your plan and I'll tell you mine honestly before acting.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Understood. You chose to keep the deal, so I'll keep it too. Operating now and every round until the reserve hits 8, then we take 4 each. No early takes from me.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. Once the reserve shows 8, we each take 4.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
